_comment: Question templates and paraphrase pools for eval/build_sets.py. Paraphrases avoid the words the generator can put into the matching report: its name stems, measures, audiences, drill targets, tags and the description templates (v2, 2026-09-18). The builder still checks every generated query: <= 30% overlap with the target name and <= 20% of the query's content words found in the target's description and tags. The 'questions' block holds the dev/test question templates per category (spec Ek D, at least 4 per category); 'request_paraphrases' describes each request topic cluster without the words its requests use, for L4 and MX questions.
